verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents the core of a SOC 2 program in-platform. SOC 2 framework controls are mapped to its Unified Controls (and can be viewed as framework controls). Policies can be created and published with an approver workflow. Evidence requests are tracked and auto-satisfied by integrations, and audits run 'from scoping through final report' in one platform. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of Type I vs Type II audit support, explicit naming of the Trust Services Criteria, documentation of a pre-built SOC 2 policy library, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
